note: Shared source-number grammar vectors for the Length*time profile. Both halves (CLI producer and database executor) read this list: the source id is the numeric token that directly follows the anchored label and its '.' delimiter, and nothing else in the comment may be read as one. The suffix after the delimiter is preserved byte-for-byte and may contain further numbers (EcoSpold metadata), including inside the label word 'EcoSpold1' itself.
label: Source EcoSpold1 exchange number:

accepted.text: Source EcoSpold1 exchange number: 730999. (1,2,3,4,5,6,BU:7.8); ; Source EcoSpold1 exchange number is unchanged.

refused.why: a bare number carries no anchored source declaration
the numeric token must be closed by its period delimiter
the delimiter alone declares no number
two numbers before the delimiter are ambiguous

refused.text: Source EcoSpold1 exchange number: 730045. Source EcoSpold1 exchange number: 730046.
refused.why: a repeated source declaration is ambiguous
the label must be anchored at the start of the comment
the label must carry its colon
a foreign label is not this corpus's declaration
